modalities.evidence: the stride interval was measured using ultra-thin, force sensitive switches taped inside one shoe

output.population: Ten young, healthy men, mean age 21.7 years (range 18-29), with no history of any neuromuscular, respiratory or cardiovascular disorders and taking no medications
output.summary: Long-term recordings of stride interval fluctuations in healthy young men walking continuously on an obstacle-free oval path, measured with force-sensitive switches inside one shoe.
